translations.literal: One star Stacked Firewood is northeast of Stacked Water, supplying correctness of kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: Stacked Firewood northeast fuels the kitchen.

sentences.zh: 水位四星，在積薪東，主水衡。

translations.literal: Four stars of Water Level are east of Stacked Firewood, governing water balance.
translations.idiomatic: Four Water Level stars east manage hydraulics.

sentences.zh: 客星若水火守犯之，百川流溢。

translations.literal: When guest stars like water or fire guard or invade them, the hundred streams overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars of water or fire there flood every river.

sentences.zh: 軒轅十七星，在七星北。

translations.literal: Seventeen stars of Xuanyuan are north of the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Xuanyuan stars ride north of the Sieve.

sentences.zh: 軒轅，黃帝之神，黃龍之體也；

translations.literal: Xuanyuan is the spirit of the Yellow Thearch, body of the yellow dragon;
translations.idiomatic: Xuanyuan is the Yellow Thearch as a yellow dragon;

sentences.zh: -{后}-妃之主，士職也。

translations.literal: mistress of rear palaces, office of gentry.
translations.idiomatic: mistress of harem and template of ministers.

sentences.zh: 一曰東陵，一曰權星，主雷雨之神。

translations.literal: One name is Eastern Mound, one name Power Star, governing spirit of thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Also Eastern Mound or Power Star—lord of storms.

sentences.zh: 南大星，女主也。

translations.literal: The great southern star is the chief consort.
translations.idiomatic: The bright southern star is the empress.

sentences.zh: 次北一星，夫人也，屛也，上將也。

translations.literal: The next northern one is the lady, screen, and supreme general.
translations.idiomatic: Next north is consort, screen, and supreme general.

sentences.zh: 次北一星，妃也，次將也。

translations.literal: The next northern one is concubine and vice general.
translations.idiomatic: Then concubine and vice general.

sentences.zh: 其次諸星，皆次妃之屬也。

translations.literal: The rest of the stars are all belonging to lesser concubines.
translations.idiomatic: The rest are lesser consorts.

sentences.zh: 女主南小星，女-{御}-也。

translations.literal: The chief consort’s southern small star is female attendant.
translations.idiomatic: A small star south of her is the bedchamber maid.

sentences.zh: 左一星少民，-{后}-宗也。

translations.literal: Left one star is Lesser People, clan of the empress.
translations.idiomatic: The left star is Lesser People—empress kin.

sentences.zh: 右一星大民，太-{后}-宗也。

translations.literal: Right one star is Greater People, clan of the grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The right is Greater People—dowager kin.

sentences.zh: 欲其色黃小而明也。

translations.literal: One desires their color to be yellow, small, and bright.
translations.idiomatic: They should glow small, yellow, and clear.

sentences.zh: 軒轅右角南三星曰酒旗，酒官之旗也，主宴饗飲食。

translations.literal: Three stars south of Xuanyuan’s right horn are called Wine Banner, banner of the wine office, governing feasts and drink and food.
translations.idiomatic: Three Wine Banner stars south of the right horn mark the brewer’s standard and royal table.

sentences.zh: 五星守酒旗，天下大酺，有酒肉財物，賜若爵宗室。

translations.literal: When five planets guard Wine Banner, under Heaven there is great general feasting, with wine, meat, and goods, grants like ennobling the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Five planets on the Wine Banner mean empire-wide feasts and largesse to the kin.

sentences.zh: 酒旗南三星曰天相，丞相之象也。

translations.literal: Three stars south of Wine Banner are called Celestial Minister, image of the chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Three Celestial Minister stars south image the prime minister.

sentences.zh: 軒轅西四星曰爟，爟者，烽火之爟也，邊亭之警候。

translations.literal: Four stars west of Xuanyuan are called Signal Fires; signal fires are beacon fires, watch posts of border stations.
translations.idiomatic: Four Signal stars west of Xuanyuan are frontier beacons.

sentences.zh: 爟北四星曰内平，平罪之官，明刑罰。

translations.literal: Four stars north of Signal Fires are called Inner Level, officials who level crimes, clarifying punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Four Inner Level stars north are the penal board that clarifies sentence.

sentences.zh: 少微四星在太微西，士大夫之位也。

translations.literal: Four stars of Junior Subtlety are west of Supreme Subtlety, the positions of grandees and gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Four Junior Subtlety stars west of the purple court mark scholar-officials.

sentences.zh: 一名處士，亦天子副主，或曰博士官，一曰主衞掖門。

translations.literal: One name is Recluse; also the Son of Heaven’s deputy ruler, or called erudite officials, one name governs guarding the side gates.
translations.idiomatic: They are the recluses, vice-regents, erudites, or wardens of the side gates.

sentences.zh: 南第一星處士，第二星議士，第三星博士，第四星大夫。

translations.literal: The southern first star is recluse, second star deliberation gentleman, third star erudite, fourth star grandee.
translations.idiomatic: South to north: recluse, adviser, doctor, grandee.

sentences.zh: 明大而黃，則賢士舉也。

translations.literal: When bright, large, and yellow, then worthy scholars are raised.
translations.idiomatic: A large yellow glow means talent is promoted.

sentences.zh: 月、五星犯守之，處士、女主憂，宰相易。

translations.literal: When moon and five planets invade and guard them, recluses and chief consort worry, the chancellor changes.
translations.idiomatic: Moon or planets there alarm hermits and empress and swap the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 南四星曰長垣，主界域及胡夷。

translations.literal: Four southern stars are called Long Wall, governing boundaries and Hu and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Four Long Wall stars south mark borders and barbarian lands.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入之，胡入中國；

translations.literal: When Mars enters them, Hu enter the Central States;
translations.idiomatic: Mars inside means barbarians push into China;

sentences.zh: 太白入之，九卿謀。

translations.literal: when Grand White enters them, the nine ministers plot.
translations.idiomatic: Venus inside sets the nine ministers plotting.

sentences.zh: 二十八-{舍}-

translations.literal: The twenty-eight lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-eight lunar lodges

sentences.zh: 東方。

translations.literal: The east.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern quarter

sentences.zh: 角二星爲天關，其間天門也，其内天庭也。

translations.literal: Two stars of Horn are Heaven’s Gate; between them is the Heaven Gate; within is the celestial court.
translations.idiomatic: Horn’s pair is the celestial gate; the gap is the portal, the interior the sky-court.

sentences.zh: 故黃道經其中，七曜之所行也。

translations.literal: Therefore the Yellow Road passes through their midst, where the seven luminaries travel.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic threads that notch where the seven governors pass.

sentences.zh: 左角爲天田，爲理，主刑；

translations.literal: The left horn is Heaven’s Field, is pattern, governing punishments;
translations.idiomatic: The left horn is the celestial field and judge of penalties;

sentences.zh: 其南爲太陽道。

translations.literal: south of it is the Grand Yang Road.
translations.idiomatic: south of it runs the great yang road.

sentences.zh: 右角爲將，主兵；

translations.literal: The right horn is general, governing arms;
translations.idiomatic: The right horn is the general of arms;

sentences.zh: 其北爲太陰道。

translations.literal: north of it is the Grand Yin Road.
translations.idiomatic: north of it the great yin road.

sentences.zh: 蓋天之三門，猶房之四表。

translations.literal: They are Heaven’s three gates, like Room’s four markers.
translations.idiomatic: They are heaven’s triple gate like the four pillars of Room.

sentences.zh: 其星明大，王道太平，賢者在朝；

translations.literal: When their stars are bright and large, the kingly way is grand peace and worthies are at court;
translations.idiomatic: Bright horns mean peaceful rule and wise men at court;

sentences.zh: 動搖移徙，王者行。

translations.literal: when shaking and shifting, the king travels.
translations.idiomatic: trembling horns mean the king takes the road.

sentences.zh: 亢四星，天子之内朝也，總攝天下奏事，-{聽}-訟理獄録功者也。

translations.literal: Four stars of Neck are the Son of Heaven’s inner court, overall receiving under Heaven memorial affairs, hearing lawsuits, ordering prisons, and recording merit.
translations.idiomatic: Four Neck stars are the inner court that hears petitions, trials, and merit.

sentences.zh: 一曰疎廟，主疾疫。

translations.literal: One name is Sparse Temple, governing pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: Also called Sparse Temple—omen of plague.

sentences.zh: 星明大，輔納忠，天下-{寧}-。

translations.literal: When stars are bright and large, assistants receive loyalty and under Heaven is tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Neck stars bring loyal aides and calm to the realm.

sentences.zh: 氐四星，王者之宿宮，-{后}-妃之府，休解之房。

translations.literal: Four stars of Base are the king’s lodging palace, consorts’ mansions, chamber of rest and ease.
translations.idiomatic: Four Base stars are the royal bedchamber and harem’s hall of ease.

sentences.zh: 前二星，-{適}-也，-{後}-二星，妾也。

translations.literal: The front two stars are the principal wife; the rear two stars are concubines.
translations.idiomatic: The forward pair is the queen, the rear pair her rivals.

sentences.zh: -{後}-二星大，則臣奉度。

translations.literal: When the rear two stars are large, then ministers observe measure.
translations.idiomatic: Large rear stars mean ministers keep discipline.

sentences.zh: 房四星，爲明堂，天子布政之宮也，亦四輔也。

translations.literal: Four stars of Room are Bright Hall, the palace where the Son of Heaven spreads government, also the four supports.
translations.idiomatic: Four Room stars are the Bright Hall of policy—also the four assistants.

sentences.zh: 下第一星，上將也；

translations.literal: The lower first star is supreme general;
translations.idiomatic: The lowest is the supreme general;

sentences.zh: 次，次將也；

translations.literal: the next, vice general;
translations.idiomatic: next up, the vice general;

sentences.zh: 次，次相也；

translations.literal: the next, vice minister;
translations.idiomatic: then the vice minister;

sentences.zh: 上星，上相也。

translations.literal: the upper star, supreme minister.
translations.idiomatic: the top star, supreme minister.

sentences.zh: 南二星君位，北二星夫人位。

translations.literal: The two southern stars are the lord’s position, the two northern stars the lady’s position.
translations.idiomatic: The southern pair marks ruler and consort north pair.

sentences.zh: 又爲四表，中間爲天衢，爲天關，黃道之所經也。

translations.literal: Again they are the four markers; in the middle is Heaven’s thoroughfare, Heaven’s Gate, where the Yellow Road passes.
translations.idiomatic: They are four posts flanking the celestial highway where the ecliptic runs.

sentences.zh: 南間曰陽環，其南曰太陽；

translations.literal: The southern interval is called Yang Ring; south of it is Grand Yang;
translations.idiomatic: The south gap is the Yang ring beyond which lies great yang;

sentences.zh: 北間曰陰間，其北曰太陰。

translations.literal: the northern interval is called Yin Interval; north of it is Grand Yin.
translations.idiomatic: the north gap is yin interval leading to great yin.

sentences.zh: 七曜由乎天衢，則天下平和；

translations.literal: When the seven luminaries pass by Heaven’s Thoroughfare, then under Heaven is peaceful and level;
translations.idiomatic: Planets on the central road mean balance;

sentences.zh: 由陽道則旱喪；

translations.literal: when by the yang road then drought and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: on the yang detour, drought and mourning;

sentences.zh: 由陰道則水兵。

translations.literal: when by the yin road then flood and arms.
translations.idiomatic: on the yin detour, floods and war.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天駟，爲天馬，主車駕。

translations.literal: Again it is called Heaven’s Team, Heaven’s horse, governing chariots and teams.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the celestial team—chariot stars.

sentences.zh: 南星曰左驂，次左服，次右服；

translations.literal: The southern star is called left trace-horse, next left yoke-horse, next right yoke-horse;
translations.idiomatic: South to north: left outrigger, left shaft horse, right shaft horse;

sentences.zh: 次右驂。

translations.literal: next right trace-horse.
translations.idiomatic: then the right outrigger.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天廄，又主開閉，爲畜藏之所由也。

translations.literal: Again it is called Heaven’s Stable, again governing opening and closing, whereby livestock and stores pass.
translations.idiomatic: Also Heaven’s Stable—gates for herds and granaries.

sentences.zh: 房星明，則王者明；

translations.literal: When Room stars are bright, then the king is bright;
translations.idiomatic: Bright Room means a bright king;

sentences.zh: 驂星大，則兵起；

translations.literal: when trace-horse stars are large, then troops rise;
translations.idiomatic: large outriggers mean mobilization;

sentences.zh: 星離，民流。

translations.literal: when stars separate, the people drift.
translations.idiomatic: scattered stars drive the people to flight.

sentences.zh: 又北二小星曰鉤鈐，房之鈐鍵，天之管籥，主閉鍵天心也。

translations.literal: Again two small stars north are called Hook and Hasp, Room’s lock and key, Heaven’s pipe and bolt, governing closing and opening the heart of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Two little Hook-and-Hasp stars north are heaven’s lock on the royal heart.

sentences.zh: 明而近房，天下同心。

translations.literal: When bright and near Room, under Heaven shares one mind.
translations.idiomatic: Bright hasps snug to Room unite the realm.

sentences.zh: 鉤鈐間有星及疎坼，則地動河淸。

translations.literal: When there is a star between hook and hasp or they gape apart, then earth quakes and rivers clear.
translations.idiomatic: A stranger between them or a gap means quakes and drained rivers.

sentences.zh: 心三星，天王正位也。

translations.literal: Three stars of Heart are the celestial king’s correct position.
translations.idiomatic: Three Heart stars are the king’s seat.

sentences.zh: 中星曰明堂，天子位，爲大辰，主天下之賞罰。

translations.literal: The middle star is called Bright Hall, the Son of Heaven’s position, is the great chronogram, governing rewards and punishments under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The center is Bright Hall—the throne that wields reward and blame.

sentences.zh: 天下變動，心星見祥。

translations.literal: When under Heaven there is change and motion, Heart stars show auspices.
translations.idiomatic: National upheaval writes itself on the Heart.

sentences.zh: 星明大，天下同。

translations.literal: When stars are bright and large, under Heaven is united.
translations.idiomatic: A bright Heart means the realm stands together.

sentences.zh: 前星爲太子，-{後}-星爲庶子。

translations.literal: The forward star is heir apparent, the rear star sons of concubines.
translations.idiomatic: The front star is the heir, the rear cadet sons.

sentences.zh: 心星直，則王失勢。

translations.literal: When Heart stars are straight, the king loses power.
translations.idiomatic: A straightened Heart strips the king of leverage.

sentences.zh: 尾九星，後宮之塲，妃-{后}-之府。

translations.literal: Nine stars of Tail are the rear palace’s arena, consorts’ mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Tail stars are the harem’s ground.

sentences.zh: 上第一星，-{后}-也；

translations.literal: The upper first star is the empress;
translations.idiomatic: The tip star is the queen;

sentences.zh: 次三星，夫人；

translations.literal: the next three stars, ladies;
translations.idiomatic: the next three, noble consorts;

sentences.zh: 次星，嬪妾。

translations.literal: the next stars, concubines.
translations.idiomatic: the rest, concubines.

sentences.zh: 第三星傍一星名曰神宮，解衣之内室。

translations.literal: Beside the third star one star is called Spirit Palace, inner chamber of doffing robes.
translations.idiomatic: Beside the third sits Spirit Palace—the inner boudoir.

sentences.zh: 尾亦爲九子，星色欲均明，大小相承，則-{後}-宮有敘，多子孫。

translations.literal: Tail also means nine sons; star colors desire to be even and bright, sizes succeeding one another, then the rear palace is ordered and there are many descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Tail is also nine sons: even bright ranks mean an orderly harem and many heirs.

sentences.zh: 箕四星，亦-{後}-宮妃-{后}-之府。

translations.literal: Four stars of Winnowing Basket are also rear palace consorts’ mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Four Basket stars likewise image the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天津，一曰天鷄，主八風。

translations.literal: Again called Celestial Ford, one name Heaven’s Cock, governing the eight winds.
translations.idiomatic: Also Celestial Ford or Sky Cock—master of the eight winds.

sentences.zh: 凡日月宿在箕、東壁、翼、軫者風起。

translations.literal: Generally when sun and moon lodge in Basket, eastern Wall, Wings, or Axle-Tree, wind rises.
translations.idiomatic: Sun or moon in Basket, Wall, Wings, or Chariot always raises wind.

sentences.zh: 又主口舌，主客蠻夷胡貉；

translations.literal: Again they govern mouth and tongue, guests and southern and northern barbarians;
translations.idiomatic: They rule speech, envoys, and frontier tribes;

sentences.zh: 故蠻胡將動，先表箕焉。

translations.literal: therefore when southern and northern Hu are about to move, they first show in Basket.
translations.idiomatic: so barbarian stirrings first flicker in the Basket.

sentences.zh: 北方。

translations.literal: The north.
translations.idiomatic: The northern quarter

sentences.zh: 南-{斗}-六星，天廟也，丞相太宰之位，主褒賢進士，稟授爵祿。

translations.literal: Six stars of Southern Dipper are Heaven’s temple, position of chancellor and grand steward, governing praising worthies, advancing scholars, receiving and conferring ennoblements and stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Six Southern Dipper stars are the celestial temple of chancellor—raising talent and paying ranks.

sentences.zh: 又主兵，一曰天機。

translations.literal: Again they govern arms; one name is Heaven’s Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: They also command war—called Heaven’s Pivot.

sentences.zh: 南二星魁，天梁也。

translations.literal: The southern two stars are the bowl, Heaven’s Ridge-beam.
translations.idiomatic: The southern pair is the bowl, heaven’s roof-beam.

sentences.zh: 中央二星，天相也。

translations.literal: The central two stars are Heaven’s Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The middle pair is the celestial minister.

sentences.zh: 北二星，天府庭也，亦爲壽命之期也。

translations.literal: The northern two stars are Heaven’s Palace courtyard, also the term of life span.
translations.idiomatic: The northern pair is the court yard and span of life.

sentences.zh: 將有天子之事，占-{於}--{斗}-。

translations.literal: When there are affairs of the Son of Heaven about to be, one divines from the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Royal crises are read from this Dipper.

sentences.zh: -{斗}-星盛明，王道平和，爵祿行。

translations.literal: When Dipper stars are flourishing and bright, the kingly way is peaceful and even and ennoblements and stipends proceed.
translations.idiomatic: A blazing Dipper means smooth rule and flowing honors.

sentences.zh: 牽牛六星，天之關梁，主犧牲事。

translations.literal: Six stars of Herd-Boy are Heaven’s barrier bridge, governing sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: Six Herd-Boy stars are the sky’s toll bridge and sacrificial herd.

sentences.zh: 其北二星，一曰即路，一曰聚火。

translations.literal: Its northern two stars, one name is Immediate Road, one name is Gathered Fire.
translations.idiomatic: The northern pair is Immediate Road and Gathered Fire.

sentences.zh: 又曰，上一星主道路，次二星主關梁，次三星主南越。

translations.literal: Again it is said, the upper one star governs roads, the next two govern passes and bridges, the next three govern southern Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Another count: top star roads, next pair fords, last three for Yue.

sentences.zh: 搖動變色則占之。

translations.literal: When they shake and change color, then one divines them.
translations.idiomatic: Shifts in hue demand divination.

sentences.zh: 星明大，王道昌，關梁通。

translations.literal: When stars are bright and large, the kingly way flourishes and passes and bridges are open.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Herd-Boy means open roads and thriving rule.

sentences.zh: 須女四星，天少府也。

translations.literal: Four stars of Maid are Heaven’s junior treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Four Maid stars are the lesser treasury of heaven.

sentences.zh: 須，賤妾之稱，婦職之卑者也，主布帛裁-{制}-嫁娶。

translations.literal: Maid is the title of low concubine, the low among women’s offices, governing cloth and silk, cutting and sewing, marriage and taking wife.
translations.idiomatic: “Maid” names the low consort’s work—cloth, tailoring, and weddings.

sentences.zh: 虚二星，塚宰之官也，主北方邑居廟堂祭祀祝禱事，又主死喪哭泣。

translations.literal: Two stars of Emptiness are the minister of education’s office, governing northern settlements, temple halls, sacrifice, prayer, and blessing, again governing death, mourning, and weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Two Emptiness stars are the grand tutor’s seat—rites, prayer, death, and keening.

sentences.zh: 危三星，主天府天市架屋；

translations.literal: Three stars of Rooftop govern Heaven’s treasury and celestial market and raising houses;
translations.idiomatic: Three Rooftop stars roof heaven’s vault and market;

sentences.zh: -{餘}-同虚占。

translations.literal: the rest are divined like Emptiness.
translations.idiomatic: the rest read like Emptiness.

sentences.zh: 墳墓四星，屬危之下，主死喪哭泣，爲墳墓也。

translations.literal: Four stars of Tombs belong below Rooftop, governing death, mourning, and weeping, being tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Four Tomb stars under Rooftop mean burials and grief.

sentences.zh: 營室二星，天子之宮也。

translations.literal: Two stars of Encampment are the Son of Heaven’s palace.
translations.idiomatic: Two Encampment stars are the royal palace.

sentences.zh: 一曰玄宮，一曰淸廟，又爲軍糧之府及土功事。

translations.literal: One name is Dark Palace, one name Pure Temple, again they are the granary of army provisions and earthworks affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Called Dark Palace or Pure Temple—also army granary and public works.

sentences.zh: 星明，國昌；

translations.literal: When stars are bright, the state flourishes;
translations.idiomatic: Bright Encampment means a thriving state;

sentences.zh: 小不明，祠祀鬼神不享。

translations.literal: small and not bright, sacrifice to ghosts and spirits is not enjoyed.
translations.idiomatic: dim stars mean the spirits refuse sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 離宮六星，天子之別宮，主隱藏休息之所。

translations.literal: Six stars of Detached Palace are the Son of Heaven’s separate palaces, governing places of hiding, rest, and repose.
translations.idiomatic: Six Detached Palace stars are the emperor’s lodges for hidden rest.

sentences.zh: 東壁二星，主文章，天下圖書之秘府也。

translations.literal: Two stars of eastern Wall govern pattern and text, secret treasury of maps and books under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Two eastern Wall stars are the archive of learning.

sentences.zh: 星明，王者興，道-{術}-行，國多君子；

translations.literal: When stars are bright, the king rises, the way and arts proceed, the state has many gentlemen;
translations.idiomatic: Brightness brings culture and many gentlemen;

sentences.zh: 星失色，大小不同，王者好武，經士不用，圖書隱；

translations.literal: when stars lose color, sizes not the same, the king likes arms, classicists are not used, maps and books are hidden;
translations.idiomatic: mismatched dim stars mean martial kings and hidden libraries;

sentences.zh: 星動，則有土功。

translations.literal: when stars move, there are earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: motion means great construction.

sentences.zh: 西方。

translations.literal: The west.
translations.idiomatic: The western quarter

sentences.zh: 奎十六星，天之武庫也。

translations.literal: Sixteen stars of Legs are Heaven’s martial storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Legs stars are heaven’s armory.

sentences.zh: 一曰天豕，亦曰封豕。

translations.literal: One name is Heaven’s Pig, also called Sealed Pig.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Celestial Boar or the “sealed pig.”

sentences.zh: 主以兵禁暴，又主溝瀆。

translations.literal: It governs by arms forbidding violence, again governing ditches and drains.
translations.idiomatic: It stands for military law and for irrigation channels.

sentences.zh: 西南大星，所謂天豕目，亦曰大將，欲其明。

translations.literal: The great southwestern star, what is called Heaven’s Pig’s eye, also called great general; one desires it to be bright.
translations.idiomatic: The bright southwest star is the boar’s eye and the great general—it should shine clear.

sentences.zh: 婁三星，爲天獄，主苑牧犧牲，供給郊祀。

translations.literal: Three stars of Bond are Heaven’s prison, governing park herds and sacrificial victims, supplying suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Three Bond stars are the celestial jail of park herds for suburban altars.

sentences.zh: 胃三星，天之廚藏，主食廩，五-{穀}-府也，明則和平。

translations.literal: Three stars of Stomach are Heaven’s kitchen store, governing food granaries, the mansion of the five grains; when bright there is peace.
translations.idiomatic: Three Stomach stars are heaven’s granary—peace when they glow.

sentences.zh: 昴七星，天之耳目也，主西方，主獄事。

translations.literal: Seven stars of Hairy Head are Heaven’s eyes and ears, governing the west, governing prison affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Hairy Head stars are heaven’s eyes on the west and on prisons.

sentences.zh: 又爲旄頭，胡星也。

translations.literal: Again they are plume-head, stars of the Hu.
translations.idiomatic: They are the plume-helmet stars of the northern tribes.

sentences.zh: 昴、畢間爲天街，天子出，旄頭罕畢以前驅，此其義也。

translations.literal: Between Hairy Head and Net is Celestial Street; when the Son of Heaven goes out, plume-head and rare Net go before as outriders—this is the meaning.
translations.idiomatic: The gap to Net is the celestial avenue where the king’s plume escort rides before the car.

sentences.zh: 黃道之所經也。

translations.literal: It is where the Yellow Road passes.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic runs through that lane.

sentences.zh: 昴明，則天下牢獄平。

translations.literal: When Hairy Head is bright, then under Heaven prisons are level.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Hairy Head means fair prisons.

sentences.zh: 昴六星皆明，與大星等，大水。

translations.literal: When all six stars of Hairy Head are bright, equal to the great star, great flood.
translations.idiomatic: If six match the chief in brilliance, expect deluge.

sentences.zh: 七星皆黃，兵大起。

translations.literal: When all seven stars are yellow, great armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: All seven turning yellow means full mobilization.

sentences.zh: 一星亡，爲兵喪；

translations.literal: When one star perishes, there are arms and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: One lost star is war and mourning;

sentences.zh: 搖動，有大臣下獄，及有白衣之會。

translations.literal: when shaking, there are great ministers cast into prison, and meetings in white.
translations.idiomatic: tremors jail high ministers and summon white-clad councils.

sentences.zh: 大而數盡動若跳躍者，胡兵大起。

translations.literal: When large and repeatedly all move as if leaping, Hu troops rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Leaping brilliance means northern hosts surge.

sentences.zh: 畢八星，主邊兵，主弋獵。

translations.literal: Eight stars of Net govern border troops, govern archery and hunting.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Net stars command frontier hunts and armies.

sentences.zh: 其大星曰天髙，一曰邊將，主四夷之尉也。

translations.literal: Its great star is called Celestial Height, one name border general, governing the colonel of the four Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The chief star is the border sentinel over the four outer peoples.

sentences.zh: 星明大，則遠夷來貢，天下安；

translations.literal: When stars are bright and large, then distant Yi come to tribute and under Heaven is secure;
translations.idiomatic: Bright Net brings tribute and calm;

sentences.zh: 失色，則邊兵亂。

translations.literal: when they lose color, then border troops are chaotic.
translations.idiomatic: faded color means border mutiny.

sentences.zh: 附耳一星，在畢下，主-{聽}-得失，伺愆邪，察不祥。

translations.literal: One star Attached Ear is below Net, governing hearing gain and loss, watching deviation and evil, inspecting the inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Attached Ear under Net listens for treason and ill omens.

sentences.zh: 星盛，則中國微，有盜賊，邊候驚，外國反；

translations.literal: When the star is flourishing, then the central states are faint, there are robbers and thieves, border watches are alarmed, outer states rebel;
translations.idiomatic: A strong Attached Ear weakens China, stirs bandits, alarms the passes, and turns allies;

sentences.zh: 移動，佞讒行。

translations.literal: when shifting, flattering slander proceeds.
translations.idiomatic: motion spreads slander.

sentences.zh: 月入畢，多雨。

translations.literal: When the moon lodges in Net, there is much rain.
translations.idiomatic: The moon in Net brings rain.

sentences.zh: 觜觿三星，爲三軍之候，行軍之藏府，主葆旅，收斂萬物。

translations.literal: Three stars of Beak are the watch of three armies, storehouse of marching armies, governing escort hosts, gathering in the myriad things.
translations.idiomatic: Three Beak stars are the army’s quartermaster depot.

sentences.zh: 明則軍儲盈，將得勢。

translations.literal: When bright, then army stores are full and generals gain power.
translations.idiomatic: Brightness fills the magazines and empowers generals.

sentences.zh: 參十星，一曰參伐，一曰大辰，一曰天市，一曰鈇鋮，主斬刈。

translations.literal: Ten stars of Triaster, one name Triaster Punishment, one name great chronogram, one name celestial market, one name axe and halberd, governing cutting down.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Triaster stars—Punishment, Great Chronogram, celestial market, headsman’s axe.

sentences.zh: 又爲天獄，主殺伐。

translations.literal: Again they are Heaven’s prison, governing killing and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: They are also heaven’s execution ground.

sentences.zh: 又主權衡。

translations.literal: Again they govern beam-scale.
translations.idiomatic: They weigh justice like a balance.

sentences.zh: 所以平理也。

translations.literal: By this means leveling and ordering.
translations.idiomatic: Thus they set the scales straight.

sentences.zh: 又主邊城，爲九譯，故不欲其動也。

translations.literal: Again they govern border cities, being nine interpreters; therefore one does not desire them to move.
translations.idiomatic: They guard frontier towns and translators—best when steady.

sentences.zh: 參，白獸之體。

translations.literal: Triaster is the body of the white beast.
translations.idiomatic: Triaster forms the white tiger’s frame.

sentences.zh: 其中三星橫列，三將也。

translations.literal: Within them three stars arrayed horizontally are the three generals.
translations.idiomatic: The central row of three is the three generals.

sentences.zh: 東北曰左肩，主左將；

translations.literal: Northeast is called left shoulder, governing left general;
translations.idiomatic: Northeast shoulder is the left general;

sentences.zh: 西北曰右肩，主右將；

translations.literal: northwest is called right shoulder, governing right general;
translations.idiomatic: northwest shoulder the right general;

sentences.zh: 東南曰左足，主-{後}-將軍；

translations.literal: southeast is called left foot, governing rear general;
translations.idiomatic: southeast foot the rear general;

sentences.zh: 西南曰右足，主偏將軍。

translations.literal: southwest is called right foot, governing flank general.
translations.idiomatic: southwest foot the flank general.

sentences.zh: 故《黃帝占》參應七將。

translations.literal: Therefore the Yellow Thearch’s divination: Triaster answers to seven generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Thearch’s omen text maps seven commands on Triaster.

sentences.zh: 中央三小星曰伐，天之都尉也，主胡、鮮卑、戎、狄之國，故不欲明。

translations.literal: Three small central stars are called Punishment, Heaven’s colonel of the capital, governing Hu, Xianbei, Rong, and Di states; therefore one does not desire them bright.
translations.idiomatic: The three Punishment stars are the capital colonel over barbarians—better dim.

sentences.zh: 七將皆明大，天下兵精也。

translations.literal: When all seven generals are bright and large, under Heaven’s troops are crack.
translations.idiomatic: All seven blazing means elite armies.

sentences.zh: 王道缺則芒角張。

translations.literal: When the kingly way is deficient then awn and horns spread.
translations.idiomatic: A flawed kingly way bristles the stars.

sentences.zh: 伐星明與參等，大臣皆謀，兵起。

translations.literal: When Punishment stars are bright equal to Triaster, great ministers all plot, troops rise.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment matching Triaster lights ministerial plots and war.

sentences.zh: 參星失色，軍散敗。

translations.literal: When Triaster stars lose color, armies scatter and are defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Faded Triaster means routed hosts.

sentences.zh: 參芒角動搖，邊候有急，兵起，有斬伐之事。

translations.literal: When Triaster’s awn and horns shake, border watches have urgency, troops rise, there are affairs of beheading and cutting.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling horns mean border alarms and executions.

sentences.zh: 參星移，客伐主。

translations.literal: When Triaster stars shift, guests punish the lord.
translations.idiomatic: Shifted Triaster means subjects chastise the ruler.

sentences.zh: 參左足入玉井中，兵大起，秦大水，若有喪，山石爲怪。

translations.literal: When Triaster’s left foot enters the Jade Well, great troops rise, Qin has great flood, as if mourning, mountains and stones become prodigies.
translations.idiomatic: Left foot in the Jade Well means war, Qin flood, mourning, and stony portents.

sentences.zh: 參星差戾，王臣貳。

translations.literal: When Triaster stars are awry and harsh, king’s ministers are double-minded.
translations.idiomatic: Skewed Triaster marks treacherous ministers.

sentences.zh: 南方。

translations.literal: The south.
translations.idiomatic: The southern quarter

sentences.zh: 東井八星，天之南門，黃道所經，天之亭候，主水衡事，法令所取平也。

translations.literal: Eight stars of Eastern Well are Heaven’s south gate, where the Yellow Road passes, Heaven’s watch post, governing water-balance affairs, where law and order take their level.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Well stars are the southern gate where law and ecliptic meet.

sentences.zh: 王者用法平，則井星明而端列。

translations.literal: When the king uses law evenly, then Well stars are bright and aligned in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Even justice lines the Well stars bright.

sentences.zh: 鉞一星，附井之前，主伺淫奢而斬之。

translations.literal: One star Battle-axe is attached before the Well, governing watching dissipation and luxury and beheading it.
translations.idiomatic: The axe before the Well strikes down excess.

sentences.zh: 故不欲其明，明與井齊，則用鉞-{于}-大臣。

translations.literal: Therefore one does not desire it bright; when bright equal to the Well, then the axe is used on great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: It should stay dim—if it rivals the Well, ministers die.

sentences.zh: 月宿井，有風雨。

translations.literal: When the moon lodges in Well, there is wind and rain.
translations.idiomatic: The moon in the Well brings wind and rain.

sentences.zh: 輿鬼五星，天目也，主視，明察-{奸}-謀。

translations.literal: Five stars of Ghost Vehicle are Heaven’s eye, governing sight, bright inspection of treacherous plots.
translations.idiomatic: Five Ghost stars are heaven’s eye for conspiracy.

sentences.zh: 東北星主積馬，東南星主積兵，西南星主積布帛，西北星主積金玉，隨變占之。

translations.literal: The northeast star governs stored horses, the southeast star stored arms, the southwest star stored cloth and silk, the northwest star stored gold and jade; with changes one divines accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Each corner star hoards horses, arms, cloth, or gold—read by shift.

sentences.zh: 中央星爲積尸，主死喪祠祀。

translations.literal: The central star is Stacked Corpses, governing death, mourning, and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The center is Stacked Corpses—death rites.

sentences.zh: 一曰鈇鑕，主誅斬。

translations.literal: One name is axe and block, governing execution and beheading.
translations.idiomatic: Also the headsman’s block.

sentences.zh: 鬼星明，大-{谷}-成；

translations.literal: When Ghost stars are bright, great grain ripens;
translations.idiomatic: Bright Ghosts mean a full granary;

sentences.zh: 不明，百姓散。

translations.literal: not bright, the hundred surnames scatter.
translations.idiomatic: dim stars scatter the people.

sentences.zh: 鑕欲其忽忽不明，明則兵起，大臣誅。

translations.literal: The block desires to be dim and not bright; when bright then troops rise and great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: The block should stay dull—brightness means war and ministerial execution.

sentences.zh: 柳八星，天之廚宰也，主尚食，和滋味，又主雷雨。

translations.literal: Eight stars of Willow are Heaven’s kitchen steward, governing palace food, harmonizing flavors, again governing thunder and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Willow stars are the celestial chef and storm herald.

sentences.zh: 七星七星，一名天都，主衣裳文繡，又主急兵盜賊。

translations.literal: Seven stars of the Sieve, one name Celestial Capital, govern robes and patterned embroidery, again govern sudden troops and robbers.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Sieve stars—Heaven’s Capital—rule silks and sudden raids.

sentences.zh: 故星明王道昌；

translations.literal: Therefore when stars are bright the kingly way flourishes;
translations.idiomatic: Bright stars mean flourishing rule;

sentences.zh: 暗則賢良不處，天下空。

translations.literal: dark then worthies do not dwell and under Heaven is empty.
translations.idiomatic: darkness drives worthies away and empties the realm.

sentences.zh: 張六星，主珍寶、宗廟所用及衣服，又主天廚飲食賞齎之事。

translations.literal: Six stars of Extended Net govern treasures, what the ancestral temple uses and clothes, again govern celestial kitchen drink and food, rewards and grants.
translations.idiomatic: Six Extended Net stars hold temple treasures, wardrobe, and royal largesse.

sentences.zh: 星明則王者行五禮，得天之中。

translations.literal: When stars are bright, the king practices the five rites and obtains Heaven’s center.
translations.idiomatic: Brightness means the five rites are kept and heaven is pleased.

sentences.zh: 翼二十二星，天之樂府俳倡，又主夷狄遠客、負海之賓。

translations.literal: Twenty-two stars of Wings are Heaven’s music bureau and jesters, again govern Yi and Di distant guests and guests bearing tribute from beyond the seas.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-two Wings stars are the celestial music office and far embassies.

sentences.zh: 星明大，禮樂興，四夷寶。

translations.literal: When stars are bright and large, rites and music rise and the four Yi bring treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Wings lift music and bring tribute.

sentences.zh: 動則蠻夷使來，離徙則天子舉兵。

translations.literal: When they move then southern barbarian envoys come; when separated and shifted then the Son of Heaven raises troops.
translations.idiomatic: Motion summons southern envoys; scatter means the emperor marches.

sentences.zh: 軫四星，主冥宰，輔臣也；

translations.literal: Four stars of Axle-Tree govern dark steward, supporting ministers;
translations.idiomatic: Four Axle-Tree stars are the chancellor of shades—aiding ministers;

sentences.zh: 主車騎，主載任。

translations.literal: they govern chariots and riders, govern carrying burdens.
translations.idiomatic: they rule chariotry and freight.

sentences.zh: 有軍出入，皆占-{於}-軫。

translations.literal: When there is army exit or entry, all are divined from Axle-Tree.
translations.idiomatic: All campaigns are read from Axle-Tree.

sentences.zh: 又主風，主死喪。

translations.literal: Again they govern wind, govern death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: They also govern wind and funerals.

sentences.zh: 軫星明，則車駕備；

translations.literal: When Axle-Tree stars are bright, then chariots and teams are prepared;
translations.idiomatic: Bright Axle-Tree means the train is ready;

sentences.zh: 動則車駕用。

translations.literal: when they move, then chariots and teams are used.
translations.idiomatic: motion puts the carriages on the road.

sentences.zh: 轄星傅軫兩傍，主王侯，左轄爲王者同姓，右轄爲異姓，星明，兵大起。

translations.literal: Stars of axle-caps cleave to both sides of Axle-Tree, governing feudal lords; left cap is the king’s same surname, right cap different surname; when stars are bright, great troops rise.
translations.idiomatic: The axle-cap stars flanking mark kin and alien lords—bright caps mean war.

sentences.zh: 遠軫，凶。

translations.literal: Far from Axle-Tree, inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Caps drifting far from Axle-Tree bode ill.

sentences.zh: 轄舉，南蠻侵。

translations.literal: When caps rise, southern Man invade.
translations.idiomatic: Raised caps mean southern tribes push north.

sentences.zh: 長沙一星，在軫之中，主壽命。

translations.literal: One star Long Sands is within Axle-Tree, governing life span.
translations.idiomatic: Long Sands within Axle-Tree measures longevity.

sentences.zh: 明則主壽長，子孫昌。

translations.literal: When bright then the ruler’s life is long and descendants flourish.
translations.idiomatic: A bright Long Sands lengthens the king’s years and heirs.

sentences.zh: 又曰，車無轄，國有憂；

translations.literal: Again it is said, chariots without axle-caps, the state has worry;
translations.idiomatic: Missing caps mean the state frets;

sentences.zh: 軫就聚，兵大起。

translations.literal: Axle-Tree gathering and massing, great troops rise.
translations.idiomatic: crowded Axle-Tree means great armies.

sentences.zh: 二十八宿外星

translations.literal: Stars outside the twenty-eight lodges.
translations.idiomatic: Stars beyond the twenty-eight lodges

sentences.zh: 庫樓十星，六大星爲庫，南四星爲樓，在角南。

translations.literal: Ten stars of Arsenal Tower, six great stars are the arsenal, four southern stars are the tower, south of Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Ten stars south of Horn—six for the armory, four for the watchtower.

sentences.zh: 一曰天庫，兵車之府也。

translations.literal: One name is Celestial Storehouse, mansion of war chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Called the celestial magazine of chariots.

sentences.zh: 旁十五星三三而聚者，柱也。

translations.literal: The fifteen stars at the side, three threes gathered, are pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen pillars cluster in threes beside it.

sentences.zh: 中央四小星，衡也，主陳兵。

translations.literal: Four small central stars are the crossbeam, governing arraying troops.
translations.idiomatic: Four small center stars are the crossbeam for battle lines.

sentences.zh: 東北二星曰陽門，主守隘塞也。

translations.literal: Two northeastern stars are called Yang Gate, governing guarding narrows and passes.
translations.idiomatic: Two northeast Yang Gate stars guard defiles.

sentences.zh: 南門二星，在庫樓南，天之外門也，主守兵。

translations.literal: Two stars of South Gate are south of Arsenal Tower, Heaven’s outer gate, governing guarding troops.
translations.idiomatic: Two South Gate stars are the outer portal’s garrison.

sentences.zh: 平星二星，在庫樓北，平天下之法獄事，廷尉之象也。

translations.literal: Two stars of Level Star are north of Arsenal Tower, leveling under Heaven’s law and prison affairs, image of the commandant of justice.
translations.idiomatic: Two Level stars north are the celestial commandant.

sentences.zh: 天門二星，在平星北。

translations.literal: Two stars of Heaven Gate are north of Level Star.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven Gate lies north of Level Star.

sentences.zh: 亢南七星曰折威，主斬殺。

translations.literal: Seven stars south of Neck are called Broken Awe, governing beheading and killing.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Broken Awe stars south of Neck are executioners.

sentences.zh: 頓頑二星，在折威東南，主考囚情狀，察詐偽也。

translations.literal: Two stars Dun-wan are southeast of Broken Awe, governing examining prisoners’ circumstances, inspecting deceit.
translations.idiomatic: Two Dun-wan stars examine prisoners for fraud.

sentences.zh: 騎官二十七星，在氐南，若天子武賁，主宿衞。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven stars of Riding Officials are south of Base, like the Son of Heaven’s martial splendor, governing night guard.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven Riding Officials south of Base are the night guard.

sentences.zh: 東端一星騎陣將軍，騎將也。

translations.literal: The easternmost one star is Riding Array General, riding general.
translations.idiomatic: The east end is the cavalry commander.

sentences.zh: 南三星車騎，車騎之將也。

translations.literal: Three southern stars are chariot and rider, generals of chariot and rider.
translations.idiomatic: Three southern stars are chariot generals.

sentences.zh: 陣車三星，在騎官東北，革車也。

translations.literal: Three stars of Arrayed Chariots are northeast of Riding Officials, leather chariots.
translations.idiomatic: Three Arrayed Chariots northeast are war wagons.

sentences.zh: 積卒十二星，在房心南，主爲衞也。

translations.literal: Twelve stars of Piled Guards are south of Room and Heart, governing being guards.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Piled Guards south of Room and Heart are the inner watch.

sentences.zh: 他星守之，近臣誅。

translations.literal: When other stars guard them, close ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Alien stars there execute inner courtiers.

sentences.zh: 從官二星，在積卒西北。

translations.literal: Two stars of Attendants are northwest of Piled Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Two Attendant stars lie northwest of the guards.

sentences.zh: 龜五星，在尾南，主-{卜}-以占吉凶。

translations.literal: Five stars of Turtle are south of Tail, governing divination by tortoise shell to inspect good and ill.
translations.idiomatic: Five Turtle stars south of Tail govern shell divination.

sentences.zh: 傅説一星，在尾-{後}-。

translations.literal: One star Fu Yue is behind Tail.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yue hangs just past the Scorpion’s tail.

sentences.zh: 傅説主章祝，巫官也。

translations.literal: Fu Yue governs invocations and blessings, the shaman office.
translations.idiomatic: It presides over liturgy and the shamans who voice it.

sentences.zh: 魚一星，在尾-{後}-河中，主陰事，知-{雲}-雨之期也。

translations.literal: One star Fish is in the river behind Tail, governing yin affairs, knowing the timing of clouds and rain.
translations.idiomatic: The lone Fish in the stream governs hidden matters and the season of storms.

sentences.zh: 杵三星，在箕南，杵給庖舂。

translations.literal: Three stars Pestle are south of Winnowing Basket; pestle supplies the kitchen for pounding.
translations.idiomatic: Three Pestle stars south of the Basket are the celestial mortar staff.

sentences.zh: 客星入杵臼，天下有急。

translations.literal: When a guest star enters pestle and mortar, under Heaven there is urgency.
translations.idiomatic: A stray star in mortar or pestle foretells sudden crisis.

sentences.zh: 穅星在箕舌前杵西北。

translations.literal: Chaff Star is northwest of the pestle before the Winnowing Basket’s tongue.
translations.idiomatic: The Chaff Star sits northwest of the pestle, ahead of the basket’s lip.

sentences.zh: 鱉十四星，在南-{斗}-南。

translations.literal: Fourteen stars of Turtle are south of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Turtle stars curve south of the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 鱉爲水-{蟲}-，歸太陰。

translations.literal: Turtle is a water creature, returning to Grand Yin.
translations.idiomatic: The turtle belongs to the watery yin quarter of the sky.

sentences.zh: 有星守之，白衣會，主有水令。

translations.literal: When a star guards them, there is assembly in white; it governs water ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: A guarding star summons white-robed councils and flood edicts.

sentences.zh: 農丈人一星，在南-{斗}-西南，老農主穡也。

translations.literal: One star Old Farmer is southwest of the Southern Dipper, the old farmer governing harvest.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Farmer southwest of the Dipper watches the year’s crop.

sentences.zh: 狗二星，在南-{斗}-魁前，主吠守。

translations.literal: Two stars Dog are before the Southern Dipper’s bowl, governing barking guard.
translations.idiomatic: Two Dog stars before the bowl are the watch that never sleeps.

sentences.zh: 天田九星，在牛南。

translations.literal: Nine stars of Heaven’s Field are south of Ox.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Heaven’s Field stars lie south of the Ox.

sentences.zh: 羅堰九星，在牽牛東，岠馬也，以壅蓄水潦，灌溉溝渠也。

translations.literal: Nine stars of Luo Weir are east of Herd-Boy, dikes for horses, thereby damming stored floodwaters and irrigating ditches.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Luo Weir stars east of Herd-Boy are dikes that pond water for the canals.

sentences.zh: 九坎九星，在牽牛南。

translations.literal: Nine stars of Nine Pit are south of Herd-Boy.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Pit stars mark the southern sluices.

sentences.zh: 坎，溝渠也，所以導達泉源，疎盈瀉溢，通溝洫也。

translations.literal: Pit means ditches and channels, whereby to conduct springs, drain surplus and spill, and connect irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: “Pits” are the channels that drain floods and feed the fields.

sentences.zh: 九坎間十星曰天池。

translations.literal: Between the Nine Pits ten stars are called Heavenly Pool.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Heavenly Pool stars span the pits.

sentences.zh: 一曰三池，一曰天海，主灌溉田疇事。

translations.literal: One name is Three Pools, one name Sea of Heaven, governing irrigating fields.
translations.idiomatic: Also called the Triple Pools or Sea of Heaven—the celestial reservoir.

sentences.zh: 虚南二星曰哭，哭東二星曰泣，泣、哭皆近墳墓。

translations.literal: Two stars south of Emptiness are called Weeping; east of Weeping two stars are called Sobbing; Sobbing and Weeping are both near tombs.
translations.idiomatic: South of Emptiness lie Weeping and Sobbing—stars that flank the grave stars.

sentences.zh: 泣南十三星曰天壘城，如貫索狀，主北夷-{于}-丁零、匈奴。

translations.literal: Thirteen stars south of Sobbing are called Heavenly Rampart City, like coiled rope, governing northern Yi against Dingling and Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Rampart stars coil like a noose over the northern tribes.

sentences.zh: 南二星曰蓋屋，治宮室之官也。

translations.literal: Two southern stars are called Roof Cover, officers who manage palace chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Roof Cover stars are the architects of palace roofs.

sentences.zh: 其南四星曰虚梁，園陵寢廟之所也。

translations.literal: Its south four stars are called Empty Bridge, places of park tombs and sleeping temples.
translations.idiomatic: Four Empty Bridge stars south mark mausoleum parks.

sentences.zh: 羽林四十五星，在營室南，一曰天軍，主軍騎，又主翼王也。

translations.literal: Forty-five stars of Feather Forest are south of Encampment; one name is Heavenly Army, governing army cavalry, again governing protecting the king.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-five Feather Forest stars are the imperial guard encamped south of the House.

sentences.zh: 壘壁陣十二星，在羽林北，羽林之垣壘也，主軍衞爲營壅也。

translations.literal: Twelve stars of Rampart Wall Array are north of Feather Forest, the rampart wall of Feather Forest, governing army guard as camp embankment.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Rampart stars north ring the guard camp like palisades.

sentences.zh: 五星有在天軍中者，皆爲兵起，熒惑、太白、辰星尤甚。

translations.literal: When any of the five planets is in the Heavenly Army, all mean troops rise; Mars, Grand White, and Chronograph Star are especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Any planet inside the Heavenly Army raises hosts—Mars, Venus, and Mercury worst of all.

sentences.zh: 北落師門一星，在羽林西南。

translations.literal: One star North Gate of the Army is southwest of Feather Forest.
translations.idiomatic: North Gate of the Army shines southwest of Feather Forest.

sentences.zh: 北者，宿在北方也；

translations.literal: “North” means the lodge is in the north;
translations.idiomatic: “North” marks its quarter of the sky;

sentences.zh: 落，天之籓落也；

translations.literal: “Luo” is Heaven’s fence;
translations.idiomatic: “Luo” is the celestial palisade;

sentences.zh: 師，衆也；

translations.literal: “Shi” means host;
translations.idiomatic: “Shi” is the host of stars;

sentences.zh: 師門，猶軍門也。

translations.literal: “Army gate” is like a military gate.
translations.idiomatic: “Army gate” is the camp portal.

sentences.zh: 長安城北門曰北落門，以象此也。

translations.literal: Chang’an’s north gate is called North Gate Army, to image this.
translations.idiomatic: Chang’an’s north gate took its name from this star.

sentences.zh: 主非常以候兵。

translations.literal: It governs the extraordinary in order to watch for troops.
translations.idiomatic: It watches for surprise mobilizations.

sentences.zh: 有星守之，虜入塞中，兵起。

translations.literal: When a star guards it, captives enter within the passes, troops rise.
translations.idiomatic: A star parked there means invaders through the passes.

sentences.zh: 其西北有十星，曰天錢。

translations.literal: Northwest of it are ten stars, called Heavenly Coins.
translations.idiomatic: Ten Heavenly Coins glitter to its northwest.

sentences.zh: 北落西南一星曰天綱，主武帳。

translations.literal: One star southwest of North Gate is called Heavenly Net, governing martial tent.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Net southwest is the marshal’s pavilion.

sentences.zh: 北落東南九星曰八魁，主張禽獸。

translations.literal: Nine stars southeast of North Gate are called Eight Chiefs, governing spreading nets for birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Eight-Chief stars southeast are the celestial hunting chiefs.

sentences.zh: 天倉六星，在婁南，倉-{穀}-所藏也。

translations.literal: Six stars of Heavenly Granary are south of Bond, where stored grain is kept.
translations.idiomatic: Six Heavenly Granary stars south of Bond are the sky’s bins.

sentences.zh: 南四星曰天庾，積廚粟之所也。

translations.literal: Four southern stars are called Heavenly Granary Stack, place where piled kitchen millet is stored.
translations.idiomatic: Four southern stacks hold the court’s kitchen grain.

sentences.zh: 天囷十三星，在胃南。

translations.literal: Thirteen stars of Heavenly Round Granary are south of Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen round granaries stand south of Stomach.

sentences.zh: 囷，倉廩之屬也，主給-{御}-糧也。

translations.literal: Round granary is a category of granaries, governing supplying imperial grain.
translations.idiomatic: They are the round silos that feed the throne.

sentences.zh: 天廩四星在昴南，一曰天廥，主蓄黍稷以供饗祀；

translations.literal: Four stars of Heavenly Bin are south of Hairy Head; one name is Heavenly Granary, governing storing millet and sorghum to supply suburban sacrifice;
translations.idiomatic: Four Heavenly Bin stars south of Hairy Head store millet for the altars;

sentences.zh: 《春秋》所謂-{御}-廩，此之象也。

translations.literal: what the Spring and Autumn calls the imperial granary—this is its image.
translations.idiomatic: the “imperial granary” of the classics points here.

sentences.zh: 天苑十六星，在昴畢南，天子之苑囿，養獸之所也。

translations.literal: Sixteen stars of Heavenly Park are south of Hairy Head and Net, the Son of Heaven’s hunting parks, places that rear beasts.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen Heavenly Park stars are the celestial hunting ground.

sentences.zh: 苑南十三星曰天園，植果菜之所也。

translations.literal: Thirteen stars south of the park are called Heavenly Garden, place for planting fruits and vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Garden stars south grow the sky’s orchards.

sentences.zh: 畢附耳南八星曰天節，主使臣之所持者也。

translations.literal: Eight stars south of Attached Ear at Net are called Heavenly Tally, what envoy ministers carry.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Heavenly Tally stars are the tokens envoys bear.

sentences.zh: 天節下九星曰九州殊口，曉方俗之官，通重譯者也。

translations.literal: Below Heavenly Tally nine stars are called Nine Provinces Different Mouths, officers who understand local customs, who pass double translation.
translations.idiomatic: Nine “Different Mouths” below are the interpreters of nine provinces.

sentences.zh: 參旗九星在參西，一曰天旗，一曰天弓，主司弓弩之張，候變-{禦}-難。

translations.literal: Nine stars of Triaster Banner are west of Triaster; one name is Heavenly Banner, one name is Heavenly Bow, governing drawing of crossbows and watching change to guard against difficulty.
translations.idiomatic: Nine banner stars west of Triaster are the sky bow bent for peril.

sentences.zh: 玉井四星，在參左足下，主水漿以給廚。

translations.literal: Four stars of Jade Well are under Triaster’s left foot, governing water and broth to supply the kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: The Jade Well under the hunter’s foot supplies the field kitchen.

sentences.zh: 西南九星曰九-{游}-，天子之旗也。

translations.literal: Nine stars southwest are called Nine Banners, the Son of Heaven’s flags.
translations.idiomatic: Nine southwest stars are the emperor’s nine banners.

sentences.zh: 玉井東南四星曰軍井，行軍之井也。

translations.literal: Four stars southeast of Jade Well are called Army Well, the well of marching armies.
translations.idiomatic: Four Army Well stars southeast are the marchers’ well.

sentences.zh: 軍井未達，將不言渇，名取此也。

translations.literal: When the army well is not yet reached, the general does not speak of thirst—the name is taken from this.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the rule: until the army well is struck, the general does not speak of thirst.

sentences.zh: 軍市十三星在參東南，天軍貿易之市，使有無通也。

translations.literal: Thirteen stars of Army Market are southeast of Triaster, the celestial army’s market, enabling those with and without to trade.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Army Market stars are the camp bazaar under Orion.

sentences.zh: 野鷄一星，主變怪，在軍市中。

translations.literal: One star Wild Pheasant governs prodigies, within the Army Market.
translations.idiomatic: The Wild Pheasant in the market foretells uncanny signs.

sentences.zh: 軍市西南二星曰丈人，丈人東二星曰子，子東二星曰孫。

translations.literal: Two stars southwest of Army Market are called Elder; east of Elder two stars are called Sons; east of Sons two stars are called Grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Elder, Sons, and Grandsons line the market’s edge—three generations of stars.

sentences.zh: 東井西南四星曰水府，主水之官也。

translations.literal: Four stars southwest of Eastern Well are called Water Office, office of waters.
translations.idiomatic: Four Water Office stars southwest of the Well manage hydraulics.

sentences.zh: 東井南垣之東四星曰四瀆，江、河、淮、濟之精也。

translations.literal: Four stars east of the Eastern Well’s south wall are called Four Channels, essences of Yangtze, Yellow, Huai, and Ji rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Four Channels east of the Well wall embody the four great streams.

sentences.zh: 狼一星，在東井東南。

translations.literal: One star Wolf is southeast of Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf blazes southeast of the Well.

sentences.zh: 狼爲野將，主侵掠。

translations.literal: Wolf is a wild general, governing invasion and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Wolf is the raider star of plunder.

sentences.zh: 色有常，不欲動也。

translations.literal: Its color has constancy; one does not desire it to move.
translations.idiomatic: Its hue should stay steady—motion spells raid.

sentences.zh: 北七星曰天狗，主守財。

translations.literal: Seven northern stars are called Heavenly Dog, governing guarding treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Heavenly Dog stars north guard hoarded wealth.

sentences.zh: 弧九星在狼東南，天弓也，主備盜賊，常向-{於}-狼。

translations.literal: Nine stars of Bow are southeast of Wolf, Heaven’s bow, governing preparing against robbers, constantly aimed toward Wolf.
translations.idiomatic: The Bow southeast of Wolf is always drawn on the thief.

sentences.zh: 弧矢動移不如常者，多盜賊，胡兵大起。

translations.literal: When Bow and Arrow move and shift not according to constancy, there are many robbers and Hu troops rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: A twitching bow means banditry and northern invasion.

sentences.zh: 狼弧張，害及胡，天下乖亂。

translations.literal: When Wolf and Bow are drawn, harm reaches the Hu and under Heaven is rebellious chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Bow and Wolf strung together unhinge the frontier.

sentences.zh: 又曰，天弓張，天下盡兵。

translations.literal: Again it is said: when Heaven’s Bow is drawn, under Heaven all are soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: They say a taut sky-bow arms the whole world.

sentences.zh: 弧南六星爲天社，昔共工氏之子句龍，能平水土，故祀以配社，其精爲星。

translations.literal: Six stars south of Bow are Heaven’s Earth Altar; in antiquity Gonggong’s son Goulong could level water and earth, therefore sacrificed with the earth altar; his essence became stars.
translations.idiomatic: Six stars south are Heaven’s Altar to Goulong, tamer of floods, now fixed in the sky.

sentences.zh: 老人一星，在弧南，一曰南極，常以秋分之旦見-{於}-丙，春分之夕而沒-{于}-丁。

translations.literal: One star Old Man is south of Bow; one name is South Pole; it is regularly seen at autumn equinox dawn in bing and sets at spring equinox evening in ding.
translations.idiomatic: The Old Man south of the Bow is the south polar star—dawn at autumn equinox in southeast bing, dusk vanishing at spring equinox in ding.

sentences.zh: 見則治平，主壽昌，常以秋分候之南郊。

translations.literal: When seen then government is peaceful, it governs long life; regularly at autumn equinox one observes it south of the suburb.
translations.idiomatic: His appearance promises peace and long life—court astronomers watch for him at the southern altar each autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 柳南六星曰外廚。

translations.literal: Six stars south of Willow are called Outer Kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: Six Outer Kitchen stars south of Willow feed the court.

sentences.zh: 廚南一星曰天紀，主禽獸之齒。

translations.literal: One star south of the kitchen is called Heavenly Record, governing the teeth of birds and beasts.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven’s Record south of the kitchen tallies game taken in the hunt.

sentences.zh: 稷五星，在七星南。

translations.literal: Five stars of Millet are south of the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Five Millet stars south of the Sieve mark the grain officer.

sentences.zh: 稷，農正也，取乎百-{穀}-之長以爲號也。

translations.literal: Millet is the rectifier of agriculture, taking from the chief of the hundred grains as its title.
translations.idiomatic: “Millet” names the overseer of every staple crop.

sentences.zh: 張南十四星曰天廟，天子之祖廟也。

translations.literal: Fourteen stars south of Extended Net are called Heavenly Temple, the Son of Heaven’s ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Heavenly Temple stars south of Extended Net are the royal shrines.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，祠官有憂。

translations.literal: When a guest star guards them, temple officers have worry.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star there alarms the temple stewards.

sentences.zh: 翼南五星曰東區，蠻夷星也。

translations.literal: Five stars south of Wings are called Eastern District, stars of the Man.
translations.idiomatic: Five Eastern District stars south of Wings mark the southern tribes.

sentences.zh: 軫南三十二星曰器府，樂器之府也。

translations.literal: Thirty-two stars south of Axle-Tree are called Utensil House, storehouse of musical instruments.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two Utensil House stars are heaven’s instrument vault.

sentences.zh: 靑丘七星，在軫東南，蠻夷之國號也。

translations.literal: Seven stars of Green Mound are southeast of Axle-Tree, the style-name of a Man country.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Green Mound stars southeast name a barbarian realm.

sentences.zh: 靑丘西四星曰土司空，主界域，亦曰司徒。

translations.literal: Four stars west of Green Mound are called Earth Minister of Works, governing boundaries; also called Minister of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Four Earth Minister stars west mark borders—also read as the Minister of Education.

sentences.zh: 土司空北二星曰軍門，主營候彪尾威旗。

translations.literal: Two stars north of Earth Minister are called Army Gate, governing camp watches and tiger-tail awesome banners.
translations.idiomatic: Two Army Gate stars north watch the camp and tiger banners.

sentences.zh: 天漢起沒

translations.literal: The Celestial River’s rising and setting.
translations.idiomatic: The Milky Way’s course

sentences.zh: 天漢起東方，經尾箕之間，謂之漢津。

translations.literal: The Celestial River rises in the east, passes between Tail and Winnowing Basket, called the Ford of the Han.
translations.idiomatic: The River of Heaven lifts in the east between Tail and Basket at the Han Ford.

sentences.zh: 乃分爲二道，其南經傅説、魚、天籥、天弁、河鼓，其北經龜，貫箕下，次絡南-{斗}-魁、左旗，至天津下而合南道。

translations.literal: Then it divides into two paths: the southern passes Fu Yue, Fish, Heaven’s Key, Heaven’s Cap, River Drum; the northern passes Turtle, pierces under Winnowing Basket, next connects south of the Dipper’s bowl and Left Banner, to below Celestial Ford joining the southern path.
translations.idiomatic: It forks: the south branch threads Fu Yue, Fish, Key, and Cap past the River Drum; the north hugs the Turtle, slips under the Basket, ropes the Dipper bowl and left banner, and meets the south branch below the Celestial Ford.

sentences.zh: 乃西南行，又分夾匏瓜，絡人星、杵、造父、騰蛇、王良、傅路、閣道北端、太陵、天船、-{卷}-舌而南行，絡五車，經北河之南，入東井水位而東南行，絡南河、闕丘、天狗、天紀、天稷，在七星南而沒。

translations.literal: Then it goes southwest, again forks flanking Gourd, connects Human Star, Pestle, Zaofu, Soaring Serpent, Wang Liang, Relay Road, north end of Gallery Road, Great Tomb, Heavenly Boat, Rolled Tongue, and goes south, connecting Five Chariots, passes south of North River, enters Eastern Well and Water Level and goes southeast, connecting South River, Gate Tower Mound, Heavenly Dog, Heavenly Record, Heavenly Millet, and sets south of the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: The merged stream then sweeps southwest, loops gourds and charioteers, threads tombs and boats, brushes the Rolled Tongue, crosses Five Chariots south of the north river, dives into the Well and Water Level, then southeast past south river, gate towers, dog, record, and millet, and sinks south of the Sieve.

sentences.zh: 十二次度數

translations.literal: Twelve lodges—degree numbers.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve celestial lodges and their degrees

sentences.zh: 十二次。

translations.literal: The twelve lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve lodges

sentences.zh: 班固取《三統暦》十二次配十二野，其言最詳。

translations.literal: Ban Gu took the twelve lodges of the Triple Concordance Calendar matching the twelve wildernesses; his words are the most detailed.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Gu matched the Triple Concordance lodges to the twelve regions in fullest detail.

sentences.zh: 又有費直説《周易》、蔡邕《月令章句》，所言頗有先-{後}-。

translations.literal: There are also Fei Zhi’s exposition of the Zhou Changes and Cai Yong’s Monthly Ordinance sentences; what they say differs somewhat in order.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi’s Zhou yi gloss and Cai Yong’s monthly ordinances disagree on where each lodge begins.

sentences.zh: 魏太史令陳卓更言郡國所入宿度，今附而次之。

translations.literal: Wei Grand Astrologer Chen Zhuo again stated the degrees by which commanderies enter lodges; now I append and order them.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhuo of Wei added county-level ingress degrees, which I append in order.

sentences.zh: 自軫十二度至氐四度爲壽星，-{于}-辰在辰，鄭之分野，屬兗州。

translations.literal: From Axle-Tree twelve du to Base four du is Shouxing; in branches it is at chen; it is Zheng’s division, belonging to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shouxing runs from 12° in Axle-Tree to 4° in Base—earthly chen—Zheng in Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 費直《周易分野》，壽星起軫七度。

translations.literal: Fei Zhi’s Zhou Changes division of the wilds: Shouxing begins at Axle-Tree seven du.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi starts Shouxing at Axle-Tree 7°.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕《月令章句》，壽星起軫六度。

translations.literal: Cai Yong’s Monthly Ordinance sentences: Shouxing begins at Axle-Tree six du.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yong starts it one degree earlier.

sentences.zh: 自氐五度至尾九度爲大火，-{於}-辰在卯，宋之分野，屬豫州。

translations.literal: From Base five du to Tail nine du is Great Fire; in branches it is at mao; it is Song’s division, belonging to Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Great Fire spans Base 5° to Tail 9°—mao—Song in Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 費直，起氐十一度。

translations.literal: Fei Zhi: begins Base eleven du.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi begins at Base 11°.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕，起亢八度。

translations.literal: Cai Yong: begins Neck eight du.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yong begins at Neck 8°.

sentences.zh: 自尾十度至南-{斗}-十一度爲析木，-{於}-辰在寅，燕之分野，屬幽州。

translations.literal: From Tail ten du to Southern Dipper eleven du is Splintered Wood; in branches it is at yin; it is Yan’s division, belonging to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Splintered Wood runs Tail 10° to Dipper 11°—yin—Yan in Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 費直，起尾九度。

translations.literal: Fei Zhi: begins Tail nine du.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi starts at Tail 9°.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕，起尾四度。

translations.literal: Cai Yong: begins Tail four du.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yong starts at Tail 4°.

sentences.zh: 自南-{斗}-十二度至須女七度爲星紀，-{於}-辰在-{醜}-，呉越之分野，屬揚州。

translations.literal: From Southern Dipper twelve du to Maid seven du is Star Chronicle; in branches it is at chou; it is Wu and Yue’s division, belonging to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Star Chronicle runs Dipper 12° to Maid 7°—chou—Wu-Yue in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 費直，起-{斗}-十度。

translations.literal: Fei Zhi: begins Dipper ten du.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi begins at Dipper 10°.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕，起-{斗}-六度。

translations.literal: Cai Yong: begins Dipper six du.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yong begins at Dipper 6°.

sentences.zh: 自須女八度至危十五度爲玄枵，-{於}-辰在子，齊之分野，屬靑州。

translations.literal: From Maid eight du to Rooftop fifteen du is Dark Emblem; in branches it is at zi; it is Qi’s division, belonging to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dark Emblem runs Maid 8° to Rooftop 15°—zi—Qi in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 費直，起女六度。

translations.literal: Fei Zhi: begins Maid six du.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi begins at Maid 6°.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕，起女十度。

translations.literal: Cai Yong: begins Maid ten du.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Yong begins Dark Emblem at Maid 10°.

sentences.zh: 自危十六度至奎四度爲諏訾，-{於}-辰在亥，衞之分野，屬并州。

translations.literal: From Rooftop sixteen du to Legs four du is Zouzi; in branches it is at hai; it is Wei’s division, belonging to Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zouzi spans Rooftop 16° to Legs 4°—earthly hai—Wei in Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 費直，起危十四度。

translations.literal: Fei Zhi: begins Rooftop fourteen du.
translations.idiomatic: Fei Zhi starts at Rooftop 14°.

sentences.zh: 蔡邕，起危十度。

translations.literal: Cai Yong: begins Rooftop ten du.
